content.short: A gaming platform providing an engaging gaming experience while bringing back the nostalgia of classic gaming.
content.description:
Battle Alliance is a gaming platform that started with the debut NFT project, BattleCats, on the Cardano blockchain in 2021, and has since expanded to include BattleDogs, BattleApes, and the Last Guardian project.

Battle Alliance aims to provide an engaging gaming experience utilizing Unreal Engine. The team has brought together expertise, creativity, and enthusiasm for art, gaming, and blockchain technology.

From the very beginning, Battle Alliance has been resolute in its belief that the future of gaming lies in the multichain approach, so we are delivering in that direction.
